explanation: The V32I mutation introduces an additional methyl group that expands the side-chain volume by ~27 Å³, creating a steric clash with lopinavir despite the minimal distance of 4.1 Å between the mutant residue and the ligand. This increased bulk at position 32 forces a suboptimal conformational adjustment of lopinavir within the binding pocket, disrupting favorable van der Waals contacts that were present with the smaller valine side-chain. The loss of precise geometric fit and complementarity, coupled with the inability to compensate through alternative interactions (no charge change), destabilizes the protease-inhibitor complex by ~0.66 kcal/mol.
